name: OpenCode
description: Run OpenCode on your hosted Subconscious model with the Subconscious provider and context settings.

help.behavior: Launches OpenCode with an ephemeral provider containing every Subconscious model. Persistent files are leftover-only: subc opencode uninstall.
options: Remove only the Subconscious OpenCode provider and plugin
Override the profile model for this launch

inputs.name: OPENCODE_API_KEY
inputs.label: OpenCode API key
inputs.description: OpenCode-specific credential override; blank uses API_KEY.

inputs.name: OPENCODE_CONTEXT_LIMIT
inputs.label: Context limit
inputs.description: OpenCode provider context limit used for compaction.

inputs.name: OPENCODE_OUTPUT_LIMIT
inputs.label: Output limit
inputs.description: Maximum output tokens advertised to OpenCode.

env.name: SUBCONSCIOUS_API_KEY
env.description: Credential, referenced as {env:SUBCONSCIOUS_API_KEY} in the provider config.

env.name: SUBCONSCIOUS_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Gateway origin for the compaction plugin, when one is installed.

env.name: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT
env.description: Whole OpenCode config for this launch; see the config entry. Nothing is written to disk.

config.name: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT
config.description: Provider, models, limits and image-window plugin, built for every catalog model.
Compaction plugin from older persistent setup. Launch never writes it; subc opencode uninstall removes it.

on.name: provider.subconscious.models.<id>.limit.context
on.note: subc sets limit.context. That auto-compaction keys off it comes only from an install.sh comment and the profile setting description.

off.name: compaction.auto
off.note: Upstream OpenCode setting. subc never sets it, and this repo does not confirm its name or behaviour.

threshold.name: provider.subconscious.models.<id>.limit.context
threshold.note: subc sets limit.context. That auto-compaction keys off it comes only from an install.sh comment and the profile setting description.

mcp.note: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT carries no mcp block. Whether OpenCode merges user MCP config with it is not confirmed here.
